annotations.text:
A — The Document
680px prose column, Instrument Serif display-l headline, hairline-separated steps. The calmest of the three and the closest fit to "space is the primary design tool". The pricing card is the page's one focal element (elevation 4).

B — The Split Ledger
Sticky offer rail on the left carrying the single primary CTA, evidence on the right. The top bar deliberately has no button: the rail's CTA is already in view, and two filled magenta elements at once would break the accent budget.

C — The Statement
The only direction using display-xl (64px serif). Its old full-bleed colour slabs are gone — bands now alternate canvas and surface, which is what the system asks for and what keeps magenta inside its budget.

LIGHT VARIANT (§2.7)
Dark is the default; this is the supported variant for Substack-adjacent pages and long-form reading.

One rule inverts between the modes: ink on the magenta fill is #0B0A0F in dark and #FFFFFF in light. The accent itself darkens from #FF2D96 to #C9146A, which is the light-safe step.

MOBILE — direction A at 390px, dark and light.
Mobile type ramp from §3.2: display-l drops 48 → 34, h2 32 → 25. Buttons stay 52px tall and go full width, the menu target is 44×44, and body never drops below 14px.
